name: Rin Satou
source: Although Rin may act stone-cold and serious, she actually has a heart of gold, using her psychic powers to save people in danger. She does not flash and show off her powers, she actually hides them most of the time and gets embarrassed when someone calls her a superhero. She speaks with an authoritative tone of voice, and she is mostly business, a sharp contrast with her best friend Naiko.
